title: Turn View
description: The front camera in the instrument cluster with the next turn drawn on the road as chevrons and a turn card, from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto; the camera shows with or without a route. iDrive 8: pick "Turn View AR" in the cluster's widget menu (from the car's next start after installing). iDrive 7: set Instrument cluster > Central display area to Map view; while Turn View is on the camera replaces the map there (Waze on cluster's map too, back when Turn View is off). Calibrate the camera once on a straight road. Needs the Turn View tool from the same source and Cluster renderer fro
